name: Utsav Acharya
summary: A **Computer Engineering** student with experience in **Machine learning, Backend systems, Applied AI research** and **Competitive Programming.** Built and deployed data-driven solutions across **computer vision,** **LLM systems,** and **forecasting through** research collaborations **and** real-world projects.

experience.title: Research Intern
experience.description: Research Intern on **3DPercept**, an open-vocabulary, training-free **agentic harness** that enables multimodal language models to answer questions of varying complexity about **3D indoor scenes**, achieving **state-of-the-art results on 3D scene understanding benchmarks**.
bullets: Designed a **mesh-native multi-agent protocol** for open-vocabulary **3D scene question answering**, with specialized agents for planning, viewpoint rendering, and evidence judgment before sealing answers.
Built a **cited scene-graph memory system** decoupling compact working memory from long-term view storage and claim–evidence links for multi-hop spatial reasoning.
Implemented a **training-free teacher–student skill development loop** that iteratively improves agent skills and tool specifications under regression gating without updating model weights.

Delivered **state-of-the-art performance on 3D scene understanding benchmarks** (**ScanQA, InteriorGS, and ScanNet++**), with models equipped with 3DPercept often outperforming substantially stronger baselines.

experience.title: Sectional Lead — Probability for AI (PAI)
experience.description: Sectional Lead for **Probability for AI (PAI)**, a free Stanford Online course based on **CS109** material, teaching the probability foundations that modern AI is built on.
bullets: Taught and mentored a section of **20 students from 14 nations** through the six-week PAI curriculum.

Guided weekly labs pairing core probability with applied builds—**inference-time resource decision makers**, **probabilistic artwork**, **MLE-based trackers**, **logistic regression test suites**, **neural network visualizations**, and **probabilistic evaluation** covering fairness and calibration.

experience.title: Research Intern
experience.description: Research Intern working on applied **computer vision** systems in **agricultural and biological monitoring** domains within a physics laboratory setting.
bullets: Developed **deep learning-based disease detection models for rice crops**, improving classification accuracy to **~93% on curated field datasets** with a **Raspberry Pi-based edge AI application**
Designed and trained **computer vision pipelines for poultry behavioral monitoring**, enabling automated detection of abnormal movement patterns with **real-time inference capability**.
Processed and annotated **10,000+ agricultural and livestock image samples** for supervised model training.
Experimented with **CNN-based architectures (ResNet, EfficientNet variants)** for improved robustness under low-quality field imagery conditions.

projects.title: MEDIWO — LLM-Powered Medical Workflow Optimization
projects.description: AI-assisted healthcare platform designed to optimize outpatient department (OPD) workflows by automating patient intake, reducing consultation overhead, and generating structured clinical summaries for doctors prior to consultation.
bullets: Engineered a full-stack platform using **React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, and MongoDB**, supporting separate patient and doctor dashboards for streamlined clinical interaction.
Developed an adaptive **AI-driven intake chatbot** that collected and structured patient symptoms, reducing manual intake time by **~65%**.
Built a **RAG-based clinical summarization pipeline** using **Llama, LangGraph, and Chroma**, achieving **92% summary relevance accuracy** during internal evaluation.
Integrated an **OCR-based medical report digitization module**, enabling automated extraction from **500+ uploaded diagnostic documents**.
Designed a **human-in-the-loop feedback framework** that logged physician corrections as reward signals, improving summary precision by **18% across iterative retraining cycles**.

projects.title: Trustilo — Multi-Agent Security Questionnaire & Compliance Assurance
projects.description: Multi-agent AI system that automates **security questionnaire responses** with a **versioned evidence graph**, ensuring every material claim is citation-backed or escalated to a human reviewer.
bullets: Designed a **multi-agent pipeline** (Supervisor, Librarian, Drafter, Critic, Mapper) over a **versioned evidence graph library**, with typed agent handoffs and cite-or-abstain answers tied to **filename and line range**.
Built agentic **GraphRAG retrieval** that discovers, reads complete evidence pages, and follows graph links before drafting—outperforming seed-only and single-shot RAG baselines.
Achieved **0.94 faithfulness** and **96% valid citations** on **CAIQ v4.1 (283 questions)**, cutting unsupported claims **8× vs direct LLM** and catching **91% of missing-evidence cases**.
Reduced reviewer time from **9.0 to 1.2 minutes per question** (**7.5× faster than manual**) while routing uncertain answers to human/SME review.
Implemented with **Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, and Obsidian GraphRAG**, with swappable model adapters (**OpenAI, Gemini, Meta**) and deterministic CI quality gates.

projects.title: Volt Vision — Household Energy Demand Forecasting for Nepal
projects.description: Machine learning-based forecasting system for predicting household energy demand and electricity pricing trends in Nepal.
bullets: Processed and analyzed **30,000+ household energy consumption records** using **Pandas and NumPy** for large-scale demand pattern analysis.
Trained and optimized **XGBoost forecasting models**, achieving **14% lower MAE** than baseline regression approaches.
Implemented **SARIMAX and ARIMAX models** for multivariate time-series forecasting of household demand and tariff fluctuations.
Built end-to-end **MLOps deployment pipelines** using **ZenML and MLflow**, enabling experiment tracking and reproducible model versioning.
Improved forecasting reliability for seasonal demand spikes with **91% prediction accuracy during peak usage periods**.
